headline: Premiums grow and underwriting improves; profit dips
summary_short: Progressive's Q3 2026 net premiums written were $22.30B (+4% y/y) with a combined ratio of 88.7 versus 89.5; net income was $2.54B and EPS $4.37.
summary_long: For the September quarter, net premiums written rose 4% to $22.30B and net premiums earned rose 5% to $21.87B. The combined ratio improved 0.8 points to 88.7, but net income fell 3% to $2.54B and per-share earnings slipped to $4.37 from $4.45, as pretax realized losses on securities were $170M against gains of $295M a year ago. Policies in force grew 6% to 40.5M. September alone produced net income of $630M and a combined ratio of 90.0. The release gives no guidance.
confidence_notes: Progressive reports monthly and quarterly together; figures here are the quarter columns (September quarter), not the single month. The shard's EPS of 4.5956 (Yahoo) does not match the release's $4.37 per share available to common shareholders, so the release value is used. The shard event date is 2026-10-13 while the release and 8-K are dated 2026-10-14; reported_at uses the release date. Changes are as stated in the release (rounded to whole percent).

drivers.explanation: Pretax net realized losses on securities were $170M versus gains of $295M a year ago, which more than offset higher earned premiums and the lower combined ratio.
